content: Wunɛ tɔnun bii, ɑ Gɔɡu ɡerusio ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, nɛ wee nɑ Gɔɡu seesi wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Mɛsɛki kɑ Tubɑlin kpɑro.
Kon nùn yɑrɑ win tem di mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeun sɔɔ sɔɔwɔ. Kpɑ n de u Isirelibɑ wɔri.
Adɑmɑ kon win tɛndu wɔrɑ win nɔm dwɑrun di kpɑ n win sɛ̃ɛnu mwɛɛri win nɔm ɡeun di.
U koo wɔrumɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuunu wɔllɔ wi, kɑ win tɑbu kowobu kɑ tɔn be bɑ nùn swĩimɑ. Kpɑ ɡunɔsu kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yi ben yɑɑ di.
U koo wɔrumɑwɑ temɔ nɡe mɛ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ.
Kon Mɑɡɔɡu ye dɔ̃ɔ doke kɑ sere be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem burerɔ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Kon de bu nɛn yĩsi dɛɛrɑru ɡiɑ Isirelibɑn suunu sɔɔ. Nɑ ǹ derimɔ bu tu sɑnku. Sɑɑ yerɑ bwesenu kpuro nu koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni Dɛɛro.
Wee ye kpuro yɑ koorɑmɔ yɑ wee. Yɑ koo koorɑwɑ tɔ̃ɔ te nɛn tii nɑ yi. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, Isirelibɑ bɑ koo yɑri ben wusun di, kpɑ bu ben yibɛrɛbɑn tɛrɛ bɑkɑnu kɑ piiminu mwɛɛri kɑ ben tɛmɑ kɑ sɛ̃ɛnu kɑ ben yɑɑsi kɑ ben bɔri kpɑ bu kɑ ye kpuro dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃re wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru.

Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ kɑso dɔɔ yɑkɑsɔ. Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ burɑmɔ dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔwɔ bu kɑ doo ko. Domi tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ niyɑ bɑ koo kɑ dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃re. Bɑ koo ben yibɛrɛbɑ mwɛɛri be, be bɑ rɑɑ bu mwɛɛrɑ. Bɑ koo tɔmbun yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ be bɑ rɑɑ ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ. Nɛ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.

Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, Isireliɔ kon Gɔɡu siku yeru wɛ̃ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuun sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, mi tɔmbɑ rɑ sɑre. Kpɑ tu berɑ min swɑɑ ɡo. Miyɑ bɑ koo Gɔɡu kɑ win tɔn dɑbi te sike, kpɑ bu yɑm mi soku Gɔɡun tɔn dɑbinun wɔwɑ.
Isirelibɑrɑ bɑ koo bu sike kpɑ bu wɑ bu kɑ ben tem dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Bɑ koo ye kowɑ suru nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Isirelibɑ kpurowɑ bɑ koo ɡoo ni sike. Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bɑ koo mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃, kpɑ bu mɔm. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Suru nɔɔbɑ yiru yen bɑɑ sɔɔ, bɑ koo tɔmbu ɡɔsi be bɑ ko n sirenɛ bɑ n ɡoo ni nu tie kɑsu bɑ n sikumɔ. Be bɑ sɑrɔ mi kpuro, bɑ koo bu somi. Mɛyɑ bɑ koo kɑ tem mɛ kpuro dɛɛrɑsiɑ.
Tɔn be bɑ bɔsu tem mɛ sɔɔ, bɑ̀ n tɔn kukunu wɑ, kpɑ bu yĩreru ko mi. Be bɑ siku ten sɔmburu mɔ̀ bɑ̀ n nɑ kpɑ bu kuku ni ɡurɑ bu sike Gɔɡun tɔn dɑbi ten wɔwɑ mi.
Bɑ koo mɑm wuu ɡɑɡu yĩsiru kɛ̃ Hɑmɔnɑ. Yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ dɑbiru. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ koo kɑ tem mɛ dɛɛrɑsiɑ.

Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ ɡunɔ bwese bwesekɑ kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, yi mɛnnɑmɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuron di nɛn yɑ̃ku te kon kon sɔ̃. Kon yɑ̃ku bɑkɑru ko Isirelibɑn ɡuunɔ kpɑ yi yɑɑ tem yi yɛm nɔ.
Yi koo tɑbu durɔbun ɡonu di kpɑ yi wiruɡibun yɛm nɔ be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe Bɑsɑnin yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu kɑ bonu kɑ kɛtɛ kinɛ ni nu ɡum mɔ.
Yi koo yɑɑ ɡum di yi debu kpɑ yi yɛm nɔ sere mu yi ɡo nɡe tɑm nɛn yɑ̃ku te kon yi kuɑ min sɔ̃.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, yi koo dumi kɑ yin mɑɑsɔbun yɑɑ di kɑ tɑbu durɔbu kɑ sere tɑbu kowobu be bɑ tie. Yi koo yɑɑ ye diwɑ yi debu nɛn dii yerɔ.
Kon bwesenu nɛn yiiko sɔ̃ɔsi kpɑ nu wɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ bu siri kɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑ bi nɑ bu kuɑ.
Sɑɑ yen dɔmɑ ten di sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ, nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni.
Esekiɛlin ɡɑrin wiru
Bwesenu nu koo ɡiɑ mɑ Isirelibɑn torɑnun sɔ̃nɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ bu biru kisi mɑ nɑ derɑ bɑ bu yoru mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ tem tukumɔ. Nɑ bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ bɑ bu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ.
Nɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ nɡe mɛ ben torɑnu nu nɛ ni nu bu kuɑ disiɡibu. Mɑ nɑ bu nɛn wuswɑɑ beruɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɛ̃ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, kon de Isirelibɑ be, Yɑkɔbun bweseru bu wurɑmɑ yorun di. Kon be kpuron wɔnwɔndu ko. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kon nisinu se nɛn yĩsi dɛɛrɑ ten sɔ̃.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ koo sinɑ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, ɡoo kun mɑɑ bu bɑɑsimɔ bɑ koo ben sekuru duɑri kɑ ben nɑɑnɛ sɑri te bɑ mɑn kuɑ.
Tɔmbu bɑ koo mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ nɑ̀ n Isirelibɑ wunɑmɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑn suunu sɔɔn di nɑ kɑ wurɑmɑ.
Bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni, nɛ wi nɑ derɑ bɑ kɑ bu yoru dɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔ, mɑ nɑ derɑ bɑ mɑɑ wurɑmɑ ben temɔ. Bɑɑ ben turo nɑ ǹ derimɔ u sinɑ tem tukumɔ.
Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bu biru kisimɔ. Domi kon bu nɛn Hunde wɛ̃. Nɛ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
